basic_details.job_title: APS Old Amritsar Cantt Principal Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Army Public School Old Amritsar Cantt has invited applications for the post of Principal on a term basis. Eligible candidates can submit their applications to the designated address by 14 November 2026.

age_limit.details: Age limit: as on 01 Apr of the Yr of employment - Min 40 Yrs and Max 50 Yrs. Max age limit for Regular APS employees and ESM will be 55 Yrs.

qualification.details: Regular Masters Degree with 50% aggregate marks in CBSE notified teaching subject (preferably being taught in Army Public Schools) from a recognized University/Institute. Regular Bachelor of Education with min 50% aggregate marks from UGC/NCTE recognized University/Institution. | 08 Yrs regular service as a PGT in any teaching subject in a recognized CBSE school. For a serving Vice Principal, it will be 06 Yrs as a PGT in any teaching subject in a recognized CBSE school and 02 Yrs administrative experience as a Vice Principal. OR 15 Yrs combined experience as PGT/TGT out of which min 03 Yrs should be as a PGT in any teaching subject in a recognized CBSE school. | Age limit: as on 01 Apr of the Yr of employment - Min 40 Yrs and Max 50 Yrs. Max age limit for Regular APS employees and ESM will be 55 Yrs. | PhD, M.Ed and min 03 Yrs administrative experience as a Vice Principal/ Sr Secy School Exam-in-Charge in a recognized CBSE School. For APS employees (PGT/ TGT) only experience and age criteria is required to be fulfilled. Adequate working knowledge of computers/MS Office/MS Power Point.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Download application form from School website https://www.armyschoolasr.org.in, certificates/testimonials, to the given address. Only hard copy of application with supporting documents will be considered. Applications must be forwarded to Director AWES, AWES Cell, HQ Western Command PIN-908543, C/o 56 APO. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Regular Masters Degree with 50% aggregate marks in CBSE notified teaching subject (preferably being taught in Army Public Schools) from a recognized University/Institute. Regular Bachelor of Education with min 50% aggregate marks from UGC/NCTE recognized University/Institution. 08 Yrs regular service as a PGT in any teaching subject in a recognized CBSE school. For a serving Vice Principal, it will be 06 Yrs as a PGT in any teaching subject in a recognized CBSE school and 02 Yrs administrative experience as a Vice Principal. OR 15 Yrs combined experience as PGT/TGT out of which min 03 Yrs should be as a PGT in any teaching subject in a recognized CBSE school. Age limit: as on 01 Apr of the Yr of employment - Min 40 Yrs and Max 50 Yrs. Max age limit for Regular APS employees and ESM will be 55 Yrs. PhD, M.Ed and min 03 Yrs administrative experience as a Vice Principal/ Sr Secy School Exam-in-Charge in a recognized CBSE School. For APS employees (PGT/ TGT) only experience and age criteria is required to be fulfilled. Adequate working knowledge of computers/MS Office/MS Power Point.

rows.pay: Negotiable, along with the other perks as per AWES guidelines

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Through panel interviews (only candidates short listed, based on qualification, experience and other criteria as may be considered by the management, will be called for interview).

rows.event: Last date for receipt of application

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Initial appointment will be for four years. On completion of successful service, the service may be regularised through a special screening board by the appointing authority subject to meeting good professional competency and other laid criteria as per AWES norms. In case, any details are found false or without sp docus, my application is liable to be treated as null and void. No TA/DA admissible. Only hard copy of application with supporting documents will be considered.
